blocks.text: DARWIN — Australia’s Indigenous population before the arrival of Europeans was up to seven times larger than previously thought, research suggests. The study shows First Nations people suffered an estimated 93 percent population loss in less than 80 years following the arrival of the First Fleet in 1788.
